profile.summary: Priority Jewels Limited engages in the designing, manufacturing, and sale of diamond-studded gold and platinum fine jewellery in India. Its portfolio includes daily wear jewellery, such as rings, earrings, pendants, mangalsutras, neckwear, bracelets, and occasion couture jewellery, as well as customized lab-grown diamond jewellery.
